statement: For every integer K>=1, put c=10K+1 and S_K={4,6,c}. Under the Sprague-Grundy recurrence and the period-first least-period/least-preperiod convention fixed in source.md and problem.md, the sequence G_{S_K} has least eventual period p=5 and, for that period, least preperiod q=2c+5=20K+7.
contribution: A full uniform proof of the frozen claim: the exact SG word is A^K 0 B D^(K-1) F W^infinity for five explicit K-independent blocks. Finite local mex identities verify every parameter-dependent seam and the infinite tail; an exact mismatch at q-1 and a gcd-of-periods argument prove both minimality assertions. This is submitted as a mathematical resolution, not as a claim of publication priority.
